_README: Live Instagram feed consumed by the front-end. This file ships with placeholder posts so the section works out of the box. In production, overwrite it during your build (GitHub Action / serverless function / pre-deploy script) using the Instagram Graph API. NEVER expose an access token in front-end JS. If this file is missing or fails to load, the page falls back to data/instagram-fallback.json.
